name: Doofinder
summary: AI site-search and product-discovery platform for ecommerce, with guided search, recommendations and quizzes.
description: AI site-search and product-discovery platform for ecommerce, with guided search, recommendations and quizzes.

pricing.details: Monthly or Yearly (10% off yearly, a regular billing toggle). Basic 49 €/month, or 44 €/month billed annually — up to 10k requests/month per product, AI search, banners, custom results, voice search, synonyms, homepage and PDP recommendation carousels, quiz maker. Pro 149 €/month, or 134 €/month billed annually — up to 150k requests/month, everything in Basic plus AI search alerts, multi-index, predictive suggestions, AI visual tagging, behavior-based recommendations. Advanced 349 €/month, or 314 €/month billed annually — up to 400k requests/month, everything in Pro plus 1:1 personalized results, visual search, 365-day analytics, ChatGPT/Claude connection. Enterprise is custom (talk to us). A free trial is offered. Shopify and BigCommerce-specific plans are listed separately on the official site. Official prices already in euro, shown as published.
pricing.label: Premium
